(2) The camera moves to a closer shot of the Taipei 101 skyscraper against a dark, cloudy night sky. The building's facade acts as a giant screen displaying various colorful light projections. The animations include a black bear character wearing a colorful vest, a high-speed train traveling across the building, and vibrant nature scenes with trees and flowers in hues of green, blue, and red. Above this inset, the main view continues to show the Taipei 101 skyscraper with shifting colorful light patterns and various promotional slogans about nature and culture appearing vertically.
